# UI.StateBinding

> Bind a GUI property to a ReplicatedState key.

- Package: `UI.StateBinding` · Category: Client UI
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("UI.StateBinding")` on the server; `Gaxia.IsInstalled("UI.StateBinding")` on the client

## `Gaxia.UI.StateBinding`

- Runs: **client only (LocalScript / client ModuleScript)**

### Functions

- `StateBinding.Bind(gui: Instance, property: string, state: any, key: string, transform: ((value: any) -> any)?): Unbind`
  Bind gui[property] to state:Get(key), updating on every OnChanged. Returns unbind().
- `StateBinding.BindText(label: Instance, state: any, key: string, format: ((value: any) -> string)?): Unbind`
  Convenience: bind a TextLabel/TextButton .Text to a state key, with optional format.
